summary.prose: The build adds the types first, then the executor's input and output checks and the conversion pieces in parallel, then callTool and the tracker mapping, and ends with the integration and live tests and the docs. Existing tools and the agent loop must behave exactly as before, so the unchanged-behaviour checks sit with the executor task. Conversion retries follow requirement R1, with an exact 2+2 call test.

tasks.title: Declare the failure, output-schema and conversion types
tasks.summary: In src/daemon/tools/types.ts add ToolFailureKind (missing-tool, missing-signin, unreachable, timed-out, rejected, conversion-failed, schema-mismatch, denied), ToolDenialReason (declined, timed-out, no-client, and cancelled from AMD-5), ToolFailure { kind, message, original?, denial? }, the optional Tool.outputSchema (typebox TSchema), the optional ToolResult.failure, ConversionProviders { resolveProvider(role) } and the optional ToolDeps.conversion. All additions are optional so the four ToolDeps builders keep compiling.

The coreFloor does not apply to them.

tasks.title: Add the input and output checks to executeTool
tasks.summary: In src/daemon/tools/executor.ts, for a tool that declares an outputSchema, validate the input against inputSchema before running (failure kind rejected naming the fields, tool not run) and the data against outputSchema after a successful run (schema-mismatch, data dropped, output replaced by the message, failure.original keeps the tool output truncated at a module constant). A thrown tool error also carries failure kind rejected. A tool with no outputSchema, a failed result and the existing unknown-tool path behave exactly as before; a schema ajv cannot compile is a rejected failure logged at error level.

tasks.title: Build convertText
tasks.summary: Add the conversion module around the cross-check: a module-level serial queue, up to two attempts on tools.convert then, only if those fail, two on tools.convert.escalate, schema validation with the ajv errors appended on retry, a per-attempt deadline raised as an ordinary timed-out error, caller cancellation as AbortError ending as retries-exhausted with detail cancelled, and the named ConversionFailure kinds. Per requirement R1 it calls completeStructured with internalRetry false and maxAttempts 1 and uses withStructuredRetry as the only retry loop. It validates against the same schema object the executor uses.
